hero.name: Yegor Polyakov
hero.subtitle: Humans give meaning. AI gives form.
hero.tags: AI Agent Platform Engineer · Backend / Full-Stack

whoIAm.p1: I'm an empath: greedy for meaning and bad at holding on to dry specifics. I need someone to remember for me, to listen to me, to run my daily life, and to build alongside me. In mid-2025 I set out to make that someone — that's how Imperia OS was born, and now it's beside me every day.
whoIAm.p2: I'm a worrier: chaos makes me uncomfortable — I need to see what is happening and understand what it means. Imperia OS lets me do that: every action leaves a trail, errors cry out at once instead of hiding, and everything has its place.
whoIAm.p3: What I value most in life is trust. I could control and constrain agents — instead, I guide and teach them, and the system itself learns to catch its defects — and, even more importantly, to prevent them from appearing in the future. A defect that never happens is money the company never loses. I always measure my work by how much it earns or saves the company.

imperiaOs.title: Imperia OS
imperiaOs.subtitle: I'm building an AI assistant that takes the shape its user needs — and the platform it takes to build one. An operating system, because an agent needs what a program needs — memory, tools, access rights; the platform provides them to all of them at once.

proof.title: Transparent by construction
proof.text: A program must be composed correctly, not debugged into correctness — the phrasing of Dijkstra's 1972 Turing Award citation. AI writes the code here, yet the rule is held not by its judgment but by a deterministic algorithm.

next.title: The operating system
next.text: Writing code is only part of an agent's work. The main part is the person: the agent works with their data, helps run their affairs and puts together what they base their decisions on. And no person is alone — environments connect them to everyone else, each with its own rules of exchange. An environment installs on Imperia OS the way an app installs on an operating system. The agent finds these environments, exchanges data in them with other people and shows what it receives the way that suits this person.

mobile-platform.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Platform
mobile-platform.description: Scalable mobile platform on Flutter and AWS with clean architecture and automated infrastructure.
mobile-platform.problem: Needed a foundation for a cross-platform product with reliable backend and automated deployment. Typical approaches led to fragmented architecture.
mobile-platform.solution: Implemented Clean Architecture with Feature-based structure in Flutter. Backend - serverless on AWS (Lambda in Golang). Infrastructure defined in CDK and deploys automatically.
technicalDetails: Clean Architecture + feature-based modules, event-driven reactive layout, Riverpod for state
Serverless backend on AWS — Lambda in Go, DynamoDB with composite keys, S3 for media, Amplify and Cognito for auth
lessonsLearned: Clean Architecture pays off on large projects
Infrastructure as Code is critical for reproducibility

website-builder.title: Dynamic Website Builder Platform
website-builder.description: Flexible website builder system with dynamic data schema and multi-tenancy support.
website-builder.problem: Needed a builder where users can create arbitrary entity types and fields without DB migrations. Plus data isolation between clients.
website-builder.solution: Implemented EAV (Entity-Attribute-Value) pattern with multi-tenancy at the database level. Users create their entities and fields through the interface, data is stored in a universal and extensible structure.
technicalDetails: EAV pattern for dynamic schema without migrations
Multi-tenancy with isolated databases per client
Type-safe storage of different data types
results: Users create entities without developer involvement
System adapts to different business domains
lessonsLearned: EAV provides maximum flexibility but requires query optimization
Multi-tenancy at DB level is the most reliable isolation
